name: Hagåtña (Guam)
description: A white field with a maroon vertical band at the hoist, charged in the fly with the round seal of the municipality of Hagåtña.
history: Designed in May 2011 by Gerard V. Aflague with the mayor's office and adopted unofficially by the mayors at the end of 2011. The seal shows Chief Quipuha, the Dulce Nombre de Maria basilica, the Plaza de España, latte stones and the statue of Pope John Paul II.

features.symbolism: the name Hagåtña, read as 'bloodline' in Chamorro

features.role: seal of Hagåtña showing Chief Quipuha, the basilica, the Plaza de España and latte stones
